title: Morning Brief — Friday, 25 September 2026
description: Today: a former NGV employee is charged over an alleged $8 million phone theft scheme; Brisbane Showgrounds early works begin within weeks as part of 2032 Olympic legacy infrastructure; and the Gold Coast's BLEACH Festival returns with its biggest ever program, moving to a spring October date. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
